note: Binds each canonical (receipt-signed) schema version to the EXACT set of fields that enter its hashed serialization. Adding, removing, or renaming a canonical field is only allowed through the additive-minor procedure in docs/RECEIPT_SCHEMA_VERSIONING.md: bump the canonical schema_version, add a new entry here, and re-baseline the determinism goldens in the same PR. The binding test fails a field-set change that does not bump the version, so an un-versioned change cannot silently alter what the receipt signs.
